decisions.rationale: Full rarity depth creates progression feel

decisions.decision: Animated drop (type='fixed') instead of real Rapier physics
decisions.rationale: Avoids sensor/physics conflict — sensors detect overlaps but have no physical response, so coin would fall through floor

decisions.decision: Distance-based pickup instead of Rapier collision events
decisions.rationale: Works with type='fixed' — check player distance each frame, collect when < 2.5 units

decisions.decision: Random spawn positions on full 600×600 table
Exclude platforms + bridge from spawn zone
decisions.rationale: Prevents coins landing on elevated surfaces where players can't reach them
More opportunities than 5, faster pacing than 3-7 minutes
Dramatic visual drop, clean hover above table surface
Visual rarity distinction — bronze=warm gold, silver=cool white, gold=bright gold, diamond=ice blue
Strictly increasing +20s per rarity, 15× original base values
Supports arbitrary jump counts (3-6) cleanly with single integer

decisions.decision: Dash system: Q key, blue orb, invincibility, 3s cooldown
decisions.rationale: Clear visual feedback, prevents spam, tactical decision-making
